integrity: The ordinary three-rainbow optimal weights and some constructive witnesses are prior work, specifically Kuzman 2019. The new contribution is exhaustive classification and labeled counting of optimal functions under the independent-zero condition on five congruence classes. Computational checks are finite corroboration; no independent audit has been conducted.
limitations: Classification and enumeration are restricted to m>=3 with m not congruent to 1 modulo 6; the remaining congruence class and minimizers with non-independent zeros are not classified.
title: Rigidity and enumeration of minimum outer-independent three-rainbow functions on Möbius ladders
